items.title: How Oldcastle APG Automates 13 Million Order Lines with Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: This post was co-written with Avdhesh Paliwal of Oldcastle APG. Oldcastle APG uses Amazon Bedrock to automate 13 million manual order lines, reducing order processing time from hours to minutes.
